title: Priority-bridge: resolve hosted API connection oscillation and coordinated customer-fallback
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Summary: Multiple enterprise customers reported repeated 5xx waves and session resets during periods of aggressive client retries. Root cause analysis points to an interplay between aggressive SDK retry behavior, our edge admission policy, and a subtle header-driven routing duplication that caused request amplification and KV-cache thrashing on the serving side. This ticket implements a short-term customer-bridge (priority-bridge) and a longer-term coordinated admission + idempotency fix.

Background: Over the last three incident windows (see dashboard link below), affected tenants experienced oscillating error rates: a small fraction of requests would begin failing with transient 502/504 and trigger client retry storms which in turn amplified load on the same backend shards. Existing per-connection circuit breakers opened but reopened too eagerly because of race conditions in our proxy keepalive recycling and a missing dedup key for multipart uploads.

Goals: 1) Deploy a safe fastpath (priority-bridge) that routes escalated tenants to a lower-fanout serving path with strict admission controls and KV-cache warming to stop amplification. 2) Implement coordinated server-side guidance for SDKs (Retry-After-Server + Grace-Backoff header) to avoid synchronous client retries. 3) Add server-side idempotency layer for multipart/high-fanout requests and tune circuit-breaker hysteresis. 4) Deliver postmortem and customer communication template.
steps_to_reproduce: Simulate a tenant generating 10% of baseline QPS but with client-side aggressive retry (exponential backoff disabled in SDK).
Send a mix of short text completions and a small number of multipart embedding uploads to trigger KV-cache pressure.
Observe edge proxy logs: rapid connection open/close, repeated requests with identical body but no idempotency token, and upstream 502/504 responses within 30s window.
Re-run with priority-bridge flag enabled to verify fastpath reduces fanout and stops repeat 5xx amplification.
acceptance_criteria: Priority-bridge deployed to hosted region us-west-2 behind a feature flag and verified with load test against the reproduced scenario.
Edge proxies emit 'X-Bridge-Mode: priority' when the bridge is active and SDKs receive 'Retry-After-Server' guidance header for transient errors.
Per-tenant leaky-bucket admission prevents sustained retries from exceeding configured burst budget (default 5 rps above baseline) and is covered by unit/integration tests.
Idempotency token applied for multipart uploads; duplicate requests within token window are deduplicated server-side and logged.
Circuit-breaker hysteresis tuned: min-open=120s, cool-down scaling factor updated, and added observability metrics for open/retry counts.
Customer-facing incident notes and recommended client SDK patch (backoff default change) in Drive are completed and linked.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Khan: Created ticket after customer escalations from two enterprise tenants. Initial triage confirms amplification loop. Will spin up devstack test harness for repro.

2026-03-11 - Ravi Patel: Prototyped priority-bridge routing shim in edge-proxy; local load test reduced backend fanout by 4x. Found race in keepalive recycling; added temp fix in proxy to avoid immediate socket reuse.

2026-03-12 - Sofia Martinez (oncall): Deployed config gate to production for 3 affected tenants; observed immediate error-rate reduction but one customer still saw timeouts — traced to missing idempotency token on SDK multipart path.

2026-03-13 - Liam O'Connor (SDK): Preparing SDK patch to add default exponential backoff and include idempotency token for multipart uploads. Requesting runtime API header for 'Retry-After-Server' delivery.
2026-03-14 - Ravi Patel: Integration PR opened for admission control and token dedup (see links). Running canary in us-west-2 with synthetic workload; results to be reviewed tomorrow.

Expand admission control to Dedicated routing layer and add config to Private manifests
Add e2e tests to CI that reproduce amplification pattern and validate priority-bridge behavior
